title: Don't Pay Attention, PLANT It: Pretraining Attention via Learning-to-Rank
claim: A plug-in attention module is initialized by training it to rank relevant tokens above others, using a pairwise objective weighted by ranking-metric change.
layout: 3 zones, left-to-right, orange callout box with token-pair ranking diagram
description: A left-to-right schematic. At far left, a grey LLM box labelled M_adapt fans out into three small boxes, Q=E, K=H_i and V=H_i. They enter a large MultiHead-Attn box (W_attn) inside a dashed region titled 'external attention on LLM outputs'. The output is a small S box (token attention per label), which feeds into a large orange-bordered panel titled 'incorrect rank penalty'. The panel shows a row of tokens t(1) to t(5). Tokens t(2) is outlined in red (j) and t(4) in blue (h). A teal double arrow marks |ΔnDCG@k|, and pink arrows lead to a pink formula box for P(j≻h) = sigmoid. At far right, an orange sigma box for token pairs leads to a teal and pink product box labelled the PLANT objective. An orange caption at the bottom says MIG relevance selects the top-k tokens per label. The eye goes first to the orange panel in the center.
caption: \plant Attention. On the left, the $\mathsf{MultiHead\!-\!Attention}$ module [ref], parameterized by $\bs{W}_{\mathsf{attn}}$, takes as input queries $Q=E$ (label embeddings), keys $K=H_i$, and values $V=H_i$, and produces $S\in\mathbb{R}^{|\mathcal L|\times n}$, the token-level attention for each label. This module (dashed box) is external to the LLM and distinct from its internal self-attention: its keys and values are the final hidden states $H_i$ of the adapted backbone $\mathcal{M}_{\mathsf{adapt}}$. The orange box highlights the top-$k$ tokens per label, $\mathcal{T}_l$, selected by \textcolor{BurntOrange}{Mutual Information Gain $r_{lj}$}. Two tokens $j$ (red) and $h$ (blue) in this set are compared, with $j$ more relevant than $h$. The module is trained to rank $j$ above $h$ ($P(j \succ h)$), with each pair weighted by the change in $\mathsf{nDCG@k}$ if they were swapped (\textcolor{Teal!70!black}{$|\Delta \mathsf{nDCG}@k|_{jh}$}); the summation box over token pairs in $\mathcal{T}_l$ gives the \plant objective used to initialize $\bs{W}_{\mathsf{attn}}$.
abstract: State-of-the-art Extreme Multi-Label Text Classification models rely on multi-label attention to focus on key tokens in input text, but learning good attention weights is challenging. We introduce PLANT (Pretrained and Leveraged AtteNTion), a plug-and-play strategy for initializing the label-attention module that operates on top of an LLM's output representations. PLANT works by planting label-specific attention using a Learning-to-Rank model trained on mutual information gain, before end-to-end fine-tuning. This architecture-agnostic approach integrates with LLM backbones (e.g., Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, DeepSeek-V3, and Phi-3-mini). PLANT outperforms SOTA methods across tasks like ICD coding, legal topic classification, and content recommendation, and improves fine-tuned LLMs in controlled comparisons outside the medical domain. Gains are largest on rare labels, although a training-free LLM extraction baseline remains competitive on rarely seen labels. Ablation studies confirm that attention initialization is a key driver of these gains. We make our code available at https://github.com/deb-official/plant
